import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# The target schema is:
# ['user_id': integer, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
# Source columns relevant to target:
# user_id -> user_id (int)
# sad -> sad.depressed (numeric, aggregate)
# stressed -> open.stressed (numeric, aggregate)

# Since source0 has multiple rows per user_id (time series),
# we aggregate sad.depressed and open.stressed by user_id using mean,
# because target examples show float values and the source columns are numeric indicators.

# Aggregate by user_id
agg_df = df_source0.groupby('user_id').agg({
    'sad.depressed': 'mean',
    'open.stressed': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg_df.rename(columns={
    'sad.depressed': 'sad',
    'open.stressed': 'stressed'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure user_id is integer type as in target schema
agg_df['user_id'] = agg_df['user_id'].astype(int)

# sad and stressed as float (mean aggregation already produces float)
agg_df['sad'] = agg_df['sad'].astype(float)
agg_df['stressed'] = agg_df['stressed'].astype(float)

# Save the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
